title: mangifera mekongensis
intro: Mangifera mekongensis, commonly known as the Mekong mango, is a species of flowering plant in the family Anacardiaceae. This plant is valued for its leaves and bark, which have been traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine for their potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mangifera mekongensis include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and exhibit antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
